body:
INSTAGRAM
Pokémon card shops run on memory. So I'm building them a CRM.
It started with a conversation in a local shop. Prices move daily, deals happen across WhatsApp and Discord, and most shops don't track stock properly.
The owner asked for three things: scan a card and see its price, match new stock to want lists, and track which contacts are hot, cold or reliable.
How I'm building it: talk to a real shop first, write the spec as markdown, then build with Claude Code (https://claude.com/claude-code). Demo first, then production.
Follow @manrajtalks for weekly build logs with honest numbers, wins and things that broke. Free weekly guide, Life With AI, is in my bio.
